title: Primary open-angle glaucoma predicted effector genes (Asefa NG et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Bioinformatic Prioritization and Functional Annotation of GWAS-Based Candidate Genes for Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma.
Asefa NG, et al.
Genes (Basel). 2022 Jun 13;13(6):1055. doi: 10.3390/genes13061055.
PMID: 35741817

The authors integrated genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic data to predict the most likely effector genes at the loci significantly associated with primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) in the GWAS performed by Choquet et al. 2018. Mouse over the column headers for details about each evidence type.
